executive_summary: Getinge delivered 12.5% sales growth (+6.4% organic) to SEK 31,827 M, but margins declined due to quality challenges in Acute Care Therapies. Operating profit increased slightly to SEK 3,736 M, but adjusted EBITA margin decreased to 12.2% from 15.1%. Multiple acquisitions strengthened portfolio (Healthmark, HPNE, Ultra Clean Systems). CE certificate suspension for HLS/PLS sets created challenges, but was temporarily extended. SBTi validated net-zero targets.
key_highlights: Net sales SEK 31,827 M, up 12.5% (+6.4% organic growth)
Adjusted EBITA SEK 3,887 M, margin 12.2% (vs 15.1% prior year)
Three strategic acquisitions: Healthmark Industries, HPNE, Ultra Clean Systems
CE certificates for HLS/PLS sets temporarily extended to September 2024
SBTi validated net-zero greenhouse gas emission targets by 2050
93% of manufacturing sites EU MDR certified (vs 67% prior year)
FDA premarket approval for iCast covered stent system
Cash flow from operations SEK 2,957 M

Cardiosave intra-aortic balloon pump delivery suspension

Discusses CE certificate suspension directly in CEO letter
Provides transparent outlook for quality remediation timeline

We demonstrated great resilience during 2023, which is reflected in our excellent sales growth
Our common purpose is to make life-saving technology accessible for more people, and to do so in a sustainable way

key_narratives: Strong organic growth despite quality challenges in Acute Care
Strategic acquisitions expanding US presence in Surgical Workflows and Life Science
EU MDR transition nearing completion with 93% of sites certified
Quality remediation action plans underway for CE certificate restoration
mda_analysis.management_interpretation: Management views 2023 as a year of solid growth execution despite quality setbacks. Focus on resolving HLS/PLS and Cardiosave issues while capitalizing on acquisition-driven growth. SBTi validation demonstrates commitment to sustainability.

Acute Care Therapies.name: Acute Care Therapies
Acute Care Therapies.management_commentary: Organic growth of 3.9% despite quality challenges. HLS/PLS CE suspension and Cardiosave delivery issues impacted results. New products like Servo-c launched. FDA approvals for iCast stent system.

Life Science.name: Life Science
Life Science.management_commentary: Organic sales declined 0.9% due to biopharma customers reducing inventory levels. HPNE acquisition adds single-use bioprocessing solutions. ISOPRIME isolator launched.

Surgical Workflows.name: Surgical Workflows
Surgical Workflows.management_commentary: Organic growth of 13.9%. Healthmark and Ultra Clean acquisitions strengthen consumables and cleaning offerings in US market. Maquet Corin operating table launched.
